note: 40 previously reviewed cards. Component scores exclude three existing Mirage alignment flags. No fresh holdouts. Full-set diagnostics recorded separately. F1 is not percent accuracy.
timingScope: CPU decoding, fixed-region offset/landmark analysis and overlay encoding; no Chromium or GPU work. Concurrent with full-set comparisons, not isolated benchmarks.

circleSummary.note: Rightmost disc only. White sun glyphs, textured backgrounds and boundary optima often fail confidence; retain them for visual review.
